name: web_fill_ref
description:
web_fill_ref:
Atomic "click-ref + clear + type + Enter" using a snapshot ref.

Same as web_fill_xy but clicks a snapshot ref instead of coordinates.
Use this when the target input is in the accessibility snapshot.

Arguments:
- ref: snapshot ref of the input element
- text: what to type
- submit: press Enter after typing (default true)
- clear_first: clear before typing (default true)
- capture_snapshot: include browser snapshot after action (default true)

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: Snapshot ref of the input element to click and fill.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to type after clicking to focus.

inputs.name: submit
inputs.description: If true, press Enter after typing.

inputs.name: clear_first
inputs.description: If true, clear the field before typing (best-effort).

inputs.name: slowly
inputs.description: If true, type with a small delay between characters.

inputs.name: capture_snapshot
inputs.description: If true, capture browser_snapshot after action and include it in tool result data.

outputs.description: Unique id for the bundled browser_snapshot when captured.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `web_fill_ref`.

Return ONLY a JSON object with:
- ref (string, required)
- text (string, required)
- submit (boolean, default true)
- clear_first (boolean, default true)
- slowly (boolean, default false)
- capture_snapshot (boolean, default true)

Example:
{"ref":"e42","text":"cheeseburger","submit":true,"clear_first":true,"capture_snapshot":true}
